messages:
samir: security-bot flagged an artifact leak from Jenkins — archive tar in S3 contains a .kube/config and a .vault-token. s3://redwood-backups/jenkins/backup-2026-03-12.tar.gz
security-bot: ALERT: CI-ARTIFACTS-SECRET detected in object s3://redwood-backups/jenkins/backup-2026-03-12.tar.gz (rule: secret-file, confidence: high) scan_id=0x7f3a
jess: which job produced the archive?
samir: infra-deploy/main on jenkins-master-3. pipeline had an `archiveArtifacts` step that zipped workspace/.kube/config and workspace/.vault-token into the backup tar
dmitri: how privileged was the Vault token? maya can you do a token lookup?
maya: looked up accessor -> it maps to a token created 2022-11-01 with policies: [ci-read, ci-write, infra-admin]. infra-admin is wide. revoking now.
maya: `vault token revoke -accessor <ACCESSOR>` completed, token status: revoked.
jess: kubeconfig — is it cert-based or token-based auth? Need to know what to rotate.
samir: kubeconfig contains a long bearer token for user `jenkins-builder` with cluster-admin rights. definitely rotate and delete that user binding.
dmitri: remove artifact from S3 (prevent further downloads) and lock down bucket ACLs. enable SSE-KMS for future artifacts.
maya: deleted object, applied bucket policy to block public ACLs, and enabled default SSE-KMS. submitted CloudTrail request for GET object events for that key. CloudTrail shows two GETs between 2026-03-12T08:22 and 08:29 from IPs 3.8.92.123 and internal host. kicking off forensic pull.
jess: run gitleaks across repo history and run an artifact scan over the last 90 days of backups. I'll queue CI job.
samir: temp mitigation: remove `archiveArtifacts` from Jenkinsfile, replace with a filtered publish step that excludes dotfiles and `**/.*` and secrets. add Masked Credentials plugin and use Vault plugin to fetch secrets at runtime.
security-bot: RECOMMENDATION: enforce server-side KMS encryption for artifact buckets, disallow public ACLs, and enable object-level logging. consider object lock / retention for forensic integrity.
dmitri: post-incident checklist: 1) revoke affected tokens (done), 2) rotate any affected k8s credentials (in progress), 3) audit other artifacts and backups (in progress), 4) RBAC review for Vault tokens and least-privilege enforcement, 5) add pre-commit/gitleaks and CI scanning gates, 6) update Jenkins pipeline template to forbid archiving entire workspace.
maya: rotated the k8s creds: deleted static `jenkins-builder` token, removed ClusterRoleBinding, created short-lived service-account + OIDC flow for CI. documented steps in INC-4321.
jess: I'll own the Jenkinsfile changes and open PR with the new publish step, plus a lint rule in the template repo to fail builds that call `archiveArtifacts` with `**` patterns.
samir: timeline for ticket INC-4321: detection 1941234567, vault token revoke 1941234578, artifact removal 1941234590, k8s creds rotated 1941234600, postmortem and compliance package due EOD tomorrow (1941238000).
maya: I've pulled CloudTrail logs and hashed the original artifact for chain-of-custody; emailed compliance and CISO with attachments.
dmitri: follow-ups: add policy enforcement in infra (S3 bucket policy + org SCP for no public ACLs), enable automated artifact scanning post-build, and integrate Vault dynamic creds where possible.
jess: :thumbsup: will include tests and a rollback plan for the Jenkins template PR.
samir: good work everyone. we'll draft the incident writeup and assign owners for the retro actions list. keep updates in the INC-4321 thread and ping here for blockers.
